threads.title: Discovery
threads.intro: Find out what the checklist really verified and which movement is the first lead.
threads.outcome_text: The checklist shows only that the display looked ready at 4:05 PM, and the grey crate is the first object-movement lead.

threads.title: Following the Object
threads.intro: Separate authorization from return and test each person's role.
threads.outcome_text: The trophy was authorised to move for a photo; its return was never recorded, and the engraving proof gives a reason to delay.

threads.title: Reconstruction
threads.intro: Combine custody, timing and motive and choose the hypothesis with the fewest unsupported assumptions.
threads.outcome_text: The records support a diversion during the unrecorded return, with Kavya as the strongest explanation.

story_events.title: Ready is not verified
story_events.body: The checklist says the display looked ready at 4:05 PM, but there is no item-by-item check afterwards. The volunteer notes record a grey crate moved at 4:11 PM with no entry for the trophy's destination. The first question is whether the trophy was moved for an approved activity.

story_events.title: The blank return
story_events.body: A movement slip opened by Kavya at 4:06 PM authorises a photo move and the return confirmation is blank. Naina saw the trophy on the table at 4:08 PM, which shows nothing about later custody. The engraving proof lists the wrong winning team.

story_events.title: A delay drafted before the loss
story_events.body: Kavya's awards folder holds the wrong-team engraving proof and an unsubmitted correction form, she called the vendor at 4:12 PM, and she drafted a delay at 4:17 PM before the trophy was reported missing. Crate G-14 is suitable for carrying the trophy but was empty at inspection, so the final location is unproven.
